description: Mission accomplished! Emergency rescue teams departed Guigang, south China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, after completing their rescue operations. Before they left, thousands of grateful residents lined the streets, applauding, waving, sending gifts, and thanking the rescuers who had stood by them when they needed help most.
title: Crowds in Guangxi bid farewell to rescue teams after mission ends

description:

Local media reported a possible explosion at a shopping center in #Kashima.
Several people were reportedly trapped or injured. Rescue operations are underway.

#Heilongjiang #Wetland #Nature #BirdWatching #MilkyWay #ChinaTravel

author: New China TV
description: Wild Siberian tigers are returning to the forests of northeast China. Camera traps in the Taipinggou National Nature Reserve recorded repeated sightings between Nov. 2025 and June 2026, a promising sign that stronger ecological protection is helping one of the world's rarest big cats reclaim its natural habitat.
title: Wild tigers are making a comeback in NE China

author: New China TV
description:
No passport. No visa. Siberian tigers are once again roaming freely across the China-Russia border.
Technology, restored wildlife corridors and years of joint conservation efforts have helped their population rebound from near extinction to more than 100.
title: Amazing China | The "Transnational Life" of Siberian Tigers

author: New China TV
description:
At the 36th Qingdao International Beer Festival, Sylvain St-Amand, a representative of Montreal Beer Festival, discovered more than just great brews. From fresh seafood to the city's relaxed coastal lifestyle, his first visit to Qingdao offered a fresh perspective on China's beer culture. 
The festival opened on July 17 in the coastal city of Qingdao, east China's Shandong Province, kicking off a 30-day celebration that blends brewing tradition with tech advances and cultural performances.
title: Canadian beer expert's first taste of Qingdao International Beer Festival

author: New China TV
description:
"If there is one mission that will stay with me throughout my life, it is telling China's story through the language of porcelain." For years, ceramic artist Zhang Chen has been using porcelain as a bridge to connect China and the world. In his studio in Jingdezhen, porcelain is more than a craft -- it is a language that transcends borders, cultures and generations. 
The Jingdezhen Handicraft Porcelain Industry Sites have been inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage List.#Jingdezhen #Porcelain #UNESCO #WorldHeritage #China
title: Zhang Chen: Using Jingdezhen porcelain to connect the world
